name: vehicle-card
title: Vehicle card
description: A vehicle listing for a dealer: photo gallery, price with an optional monthly figure, key specs as a labelled list, status in words and a save button.
docs: images is { src, alt }[] and every photo needs its alt: the gallery is a carousel group whose slides read 'Photo 2 of 6', steps with the arrows (which wrap around) or a swipe, and a click or a tap on a photo opens the listing. One photo has no arrows; none shows a quiet placeholder, and so does a photo that does not load. Photos load lazily; priority fetches the first one at once, for the card above the fold. title is make and model and the one link of the card (href, with onOpen for a client-side router), variant the trim under it. price is a number written whole in the currency and locale you name, large and in tabular numerals, or your own words; monthlyPrice adds 'or €459 / month'. year, mileage (with mileageUnit, km or mi, written with its unit by Intl), fuel, transmission and power are a description list, and a last spec on its own takes the full row. status is available, reserved or sold: reserved gets a dashed badge with a clock glyph and sold a solid one, both with the word on the first photo, both mute the title, the price and the specs, and a sold vehicle's photos lose their colour. saved, defaultSaved and onSave make a heart toggle with aria-pressed, named 'Save Halcyon E-Tourer', above the card's link; leave them out for no heart. labels carries every word.
